plan.title: Asset PR to Split-Award RFQ and PO

steps.note: Set the mandatory event title required for publishing.
Commit the 30-minute event duration; the catalog cannot explicitly verify the requested evaluation duration.
Invite exactly two QA vendors without inventing supplier names.
Publish the PR-based RFQ after its supported prerequisites are configured.
Verify that publishing reached a real project page.
Have the first invited vendor submit the requested 100 quote through the vendor portal.
Verify that the first vendor's quote was accepted.
Have a different invited vendor submit the requested 90 quote through the vendor portal.
Verify that the second vendor's quote was accepted.
Wait for bidding to end before ranking and awarding.
Open the buyer's comparison grid after both bids are available.
Verify that the lower 90 quote ranks ahead of the 100 quote.
Enter the awarding flow where the requested split allocation would be performed.
Approve the submitted proposal with the required approver remark.
Complete approval and create the resulting purchase orders; this also reads the generated POs back.
Check for two PO lines as the closest available verification of separate vendor allocations.
Navigate to the events list to inspect the event's post-bidding history location.
Open the History tab requested by the scenario.
Verify that this plan's event appears in event history.
